rows.label: bf04330100_0010
rows.name: W-what incredible strength, mo[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: bf04330100_0020
rows.name:
You'll answer a few questions.
What were you doing here?

rows.label: bf04330100_0030
rows.name: B-business, mo!

rows.label: bf04330100_0040
rows.name:
We mass-produced ether furnaces and artificial Blades
and sold them to whoever wanted them, mo...

rows.label: bf04330100_0050
rows.name:
I was threatened and forced to help
with mass production, mo...

rows.label: bf04330100_0060
rows.name: Dad...

rows.label: bf04330100_0070
rows.name:
And next you wanted to get your hands
on Hana? You are a greedy bunch.

rows.label: bf04330100_0080
rows.name: I knew, mo.

rows.label: bf04330100_0090
rows.name:
It has Professor Senzou's ether furnace
built into it, mo.

rows.label: bf04330100_0100
rows.name: That's why[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: bf04330100_0110
rows.name:
That's right, mo. It's my father's
masterpiece that even I can't reproduce, mo[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: bf04330100_0120
rows.name:
So you lured us here because doing it
in the Imperial Capital would be inconvenient.

rows.label: bf04330100_0130
rows.name: Y-yes, mo...

rows.label: bf04330100_0140
rows.name:
He was with the group targeting artificial Blades
from the start, mo.

rows.label: bf04330100_0150
rows.name:
Though Father's assistant, he sold intel to that man
at the Trading Company and had the lab attacked, mo...

rows.label: bf04330100_0160
rows.name: Then Grandpa was killed because of this guy, mo?

rows.label: bf04330100_0170
rows.name: That's right, mo[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: bf04330100_0180
rows.name:
That man at the Trading Company...
You mean the one giving you orders was...

rows.label: bf04330100_0190
rows.name: Yes, it's me, mo.

rows.label: bf04330100_0200
rows.name: B-Bahn-sama!

rows.label: bf04330100_0210
rows.name: You're always so sloppy at the finish, mo.

rows.label: bf04330100_0220
rows.name:
You managed to lure them all this way
and still failed to capture them, mo...

rows.label: bf04330100_0230
rows.name: I-I'm very sorry, mo.

rows.label: bf04330100_0240
rows.name: But I'll forgive you, mo.

rows.label: bf04330100_0250
rows.name:
You brought not only the artificial Blade,
but even Heaven's Holy Grail here, mo.

rows.label: bf04330100_0260
rows.name:
Once I get Professor
Senzou's ether furnace...

rows.label: bf04330100_0265
rows.name:
I can produce even better artificial
Blades and I'll make a fortune.

rows.label: bf04330100_0270
rows.name:
And furthermore, I'll sell off Heaven's
Holy Grail for a huge profit.

rows.label: bf04330100_0280
rows.name: Then it's all-you-can-eat Tender Mushrooms, mo!

rows.label: bf04330100_0290
rows.name:
Chairman, I can't believe you'd
do something this terrible.

rows.label: bf04330100_0300
rows.name:
You're the ungrateful one, after all the good jobs
I've sent your way, mo.

rows.label: bf04330100_0310
rows.name:
So who are you planning to sell Heaven's Holy Grail
to? Iira, I bet?

rows.label: bf04330100_0320
rows.name: How do you know about Iira, mo?

rows.label: bf04330100_0330
rows.name:
Wait, now that I look at you,
you're an Iira Driver, mo.

rows.label: bf04330100_0340
rows.name: Why are you in a place like this, mo?

rows.label: bf04330100_0350
rows.name:
The 1000 ether furnaces are loaded
on the ship outside, mo.

rows.label: bf04330100_0360
rows.name:
What? Your business
partner is also Iira?

rows.label: bf04330100_0370
rows.name:
I don't really understand, but I'll just
shut you all up, mo.

rows.label: bf04330100_0380
rows.name: Kiku, finish them off, mo!

rows.label: bf04330100_0390
rows.name: Mission acknowledged. Commencing combat.

rows.label: bf04330100_0400
rows.name: Tora, please destroy her, mo...

rows.label: bf04330100_0410
rows.name:
Muimui modified her, and now even
my words no longer reach her, mo...

rows.label: bf04330100_0420
rows.name:
Dad... I understand, mo.
Let's go, Hana!

rows.label: bf04330100_0430
rows.name: Understood, Master, mo.
